answer: Run a live presence lottery that clones cannot fake. First, each identity gets a random 60-second window each day and must answer a fresh prompt inside it, signed by a device clock. Second, three random peers verify the signature and timestamp; a late or copied reply burns a 150 POA bond. Third, one identity may wander through many tasks, but a second identity from the same device pays a 500 POA fee. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $1,500,000 in bonds plus 10,000 devices at $40 each, $400,000. Like a violet grove in bloom, each flower opens once - a copied petal wilts in the sun.
